label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: y sus columnas cinco y sus ganchos, y chapó sus cabezas y sus fajas de oro, y sus basas cinco de bronce.
spanish: y sus columnas cinco y sus ganchos, y chapó sus cabezas y sus fajas de oro, y sus basas cinco de bronce.
readerNote: «sus» is the only Spanish form available here: su/sus agrees with the possessed noun's number (columnas, ganchos, cabezas, fajas, basas are all plural), not with the possessor's number, so it cannot distinguish the 3ms possessor on the columns from the 3mp possessor on the hooks, heads, bands, and bases; marking that distinction would require supplying a disambiguating pronoun not in the draft, which resolves an ambiguity rather than repairs grammar, so the line is left unchanged.
